correctness.rationale: The map is even-halving and odd (n^2-1)/4; Ye 2026 Theorem 3 provides a complete classification of eventually zero-reaching positive odd parts as 2^m-1, 2^m+1 and exceptions 11,23,181. Direct recursions give T(2^ell(2^m-1))=ell+m(m+1)/2, plus-family adds 2; 3 is counted twice with matching time, and exceptional times are 12,20,80. Counting bounded powers up to 2^L gives L^2+2L-12, and arithmetic progression sums give the displayed quartic first moment. Uniform cutoff 2^L<=X<2^(L+1) changes lattice-triangle counts by O(L), proving the limiting CDF F(z)=2sqrt(2z)-2z on [0,1/2] and moment 1/(2^r(r+1)(2r+1)). Horizontal time rounding O(1/L) combined with the square-root singularity gives Kolmogorov O(L^-1/2). Since T(n)>=log2(n), all T<=L seeds lie below 2^L, and the two triangular C_m cutoff sums yield H_L=(4sqrt2/3)L^(3/2)+O(L), giving the positive 2sqrt2/3 lower coefficient at z=1/L. Fresh exact-integer tests for L=7..18 verified counts, sums and H_L; numerical asymptotic-gap checks at L=100,1000,10000 approach 2sqrt2/3. This is conditional on Ye classification; finite arithmetic does not prove it.
